_provenance: Hand-derived from autotuner.compute_crra_eu_tstat and compute_sortino_tstat on fixed series. These values document what the FIXED implementation must produce; the BUGGY implementation (hardcoded compute_sortino_tstat) produces the 'sortino_*' values even when called with tstat_fn=compute_crra_eu_tstat. Tolerance for assertion: rel=1e-9 (deterministic double-precision arithmetic).
_audit_finding: H-1: _haircut_select hardcodes compute_sortino_tstat(series, seed=trial_idx) at autotuner.py:1251 and never calls tstat_fn. CRRA-EU bundles get their haircut significance scored by the Sortino t-stat, not the CRRA-EU one.

scenario_1_single_all_positive_trial._description: Single trial with all-positive daily_returns (T=30). The all-positive series yields SORTINO_SENTINEL on every bootstrap resample, so compute_sortino_tstat conservatively returns 0.0. compute_crra_eu_tstat returns 19.04 (mean/sd*sqrt(T) for the series). After the fix: passing tstat_fn=compute_crra_eu_tstat must yield a winner (gate clears). The bug: passing tstat_fn=compute_crra_eu_tstat still routes through compute_sortino_tstat, producing tstat=0.0, and the trial fails the gate.

with_sortino_tstat_fn._note: compute_sortino_tstat returns 0.0 conservative fallback when all bootstrap resamples hit SORTINO_SENTINEL (all-positive series has zero downside). This is also what the BUGGY implementation produces regardless of tstat_fn.

scenario_2_two_trial_winner_discriminato._description: Two trials. Trial 0 has all-positive series (high CRRA t, zero Sortino t). Trial 1 has alternating-sign series (moderate CRRA t, moderate Sortino t). With CRRA tstat_fn: both trials clear the gate, trial 0 wins (lower p_adj). With Sortino tstat_fn: neither trial clears (tstat 0 and 1.69 fail BHY at N=2). This scenario proves both that (a) tstat_fn is actually invoked, and (b) swapping tstat_fn changes the gate decision.

with_crra_eu_tstat_fn._note: Both trials clear q=0.05 gate. Trial 0 wins: lowest p_adj.

with_sortino_tstat_fn_seeds_0_and_1._note: Neither trial clears the gate under Sortino t-stats. This is also what the BUGGY implementation produces for both tstat_fn arguments.
